report.dataset: Synthetic fuel-demand episodes using organizer seasonal profiles, random demand surges, latent station variation and demand noise. Not real-world or official-simulator test results.

split.method: Whole episodes with distinct seeds; validation determines weights and residual bounds; test is never used for fitting or selection.

stockout.definition: No new deliveries: stockout if total six-hour demand exceeds starting inventory. Derived from the regressor; not a separately trained classifier.

limitations: Synthetic held-out performance does not establish real-world accuracy.
Future unannounced demand-event starts and ends are unknown to forecasts.
Risk probability remains a planning approximation; confidence is not an LLM reasoning score.
